title: Run status
responsibility: Shows run status text and, when applicable, its cancel action.

inputs.name: RunStatus.text
inputs.description: Required status text; empty suppresses the entire area, including Cancel. Known unit references become links.

inputs.name: RunStatus.active
inputs.description: Whether Cancel run appears when text exists; no run state is inferred.

inputs.name: RunStatus.cancel
inputs.description: Required click callback. Completion and cancellation errors are outside this component.

inputs.name: RunStatus.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace for resolving status-text unit links.

inputs.name: RunStatus.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity for reference lookup, null by default.

outputs.name: RunStatus
outputs.description: Status region with linked/plain text and optional Cancel run button; nothing for empty text.
